title: EC21004: Signals And Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisite: EC21005
Introduction to signals and systems; Review of Fourier and Laplace Transforms;
LTI system: Causality, stability, region of convergence; Classification and
representation of signals, Concepts of linear vector space and orthogonal
signal representation; Discrete signals: Sampling, digitization and
reconstruction of analog signals; Fourier transform of discrete signals: 
z-transforms; Discrete systems, transfer functions and convolution; Laplace transform, first 

order and second order systems
Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion

How to Crack the Paper
Study and solve problems and tutorials. Rest depends on how professor is doing course. Make strategy accordingly.

Study it properly as it forms basis for Analog and Digital Communication and DSP in 3rd year.
